title: BDB status field
summary: Documents the bdb status field used with Redis Software REST API calls.

sections.title: Content
sections.text:
The BDB status field is a read-only field that represents the database status. Possible status values: | Status | Description | Possible next status | |--------|-------------|----------------------| | 'active' | Database is active and no special action is in progress | 'active-change-pending'
'import-pending'
'delete-pending' | | 'active-change-pending' | |'active' | | 'creation-failed' | Initial database creation failed | | | 'delete-pending' | Database deletion is in progress | | | 'import-pending' | Dataset import is in progress | 'active' | | 'pending' | Temporary status during database creation | 'active'
'creation-failed' | | 'recovery' | Not currently relevant (intended for future use) | | ![BDB status](https://redis.io/docs/latest/images/rs/rest-api-bdb-status.png#no-click)
